title: Microsoft 8K subset
body:
A default starting profile for numbered classic BASIC. Variable names have two significant characters and are case-insensitive. Reserved keywords can be recognized inside a name, even without spaces; long modern names may fail or alias. String names end in $. True is -1. Numbers use host doubles. PRINT has 14-column comma zones, positive-number spacing and seven significant digits.

RND(positive) advances a fraction; RND(0) repeats the previous draw; negative reseeding is not implemented. INPUT uppercases and requires the expected number of numeric/string fields. String CSV values may be quoted. Type suffixes other than $, hardware precision, direct memory, cassette operations and a full Microsoft language implementation are not supported. Use the explicit TRS profile for its devices/types.

Try Hello, BASIC, Countdown, A pocket observatory or Observatory tour. Verified private classic-game campaigns are separate test fixtures and are not included in this package.
